conversion: B41 WhiskeyFull is Food with HungerChange=-20, not a drainable. Twenty recipe food units per complete bottle; B42 Whiskey capacity1L: .05L/unit. B41 Disinfectant UseDelta=.1 gives10uses per bottle; B42 capacity.5L: .05L/use. Plain Wine input consumed entire Food bottle: B42 1L contents, retained native container. WhiskeyEmpty=N inputs are N empty physical bottles, never alcohol portions. B41 Bleach is Food with no hunger portion amount, used whole in the source Wash Towel recipe; B42 capacity1L therefore consumes1L contents and retains the bottle. CleaningLiquid2 was Drainable UseDelta=.02; B42 capacity.5L =>.01L per use. Mixed legacy soap/alcohol alternatives remain separate recipes because an item charge and fluid litres are different native resource types. Source Whiskey and Coke consumes whole Pop/Pop2 can; native capacity.3L, fluid ColaDiet/Cola. The separate legacy HCSodacola route is preserved.
